== Course of events ==

Having flown south aboard the Gump beyond the Land of Oz into unfamiliar territory, the travelers find themselves cast down into a hidden Jackdaw's nest filled with stolen treasures. The fall leaves the travelers unharmed, and among the plundered riches concealed there, the Woggle-Bug comes upon a diamond necklace. The Woggle-Bug gives this found diamond necklace to the Tin Woodman, Nick Chopper.

The discovery occurs in the nest itself, with Nick Chopper and the Woggle-Bug both present among the group. The moment passes without injury to anyone, leaving the party still gathered together amid the hoarded treasures within the Jackdaw's nest.
